title: Use `LocalVector` in `TextEdit`
body:

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

TextEdit now uses LocalVector where it can.
Also optimized text inserting and removing.

I made a test project that tests inserting and removing and different ways.
Tested on a dev build, from GDScript.
Results are average of 3 runs, in microseconds.

test name | master | pr | percent increase
-|-|-|-
Add all    11000 lines | 2,505,758 | 2,464,400 |   1.68%
Remove indiv 500 lines | 1,590,956 |   583,336 | 172.73%
Insert indiv 500 lines | 2,716,244 | 1,729,802 |  57.03%
Remove cont 9000 lines |   126,451 |   124,580 |   1.50%
Insert cont 9000 lines | 1,103,559 | 1,069,389 |   3.20%
Insert \n    500 lines | 1,831,433 |   777,491 | 135.56%
Reset all  11500 lines | 1,380,656 | 1,357,988 |   1.67%
Clear all  11500 lines |   114,547 |   113,255 |   1.14%

So mostly inserting and removing individual lines (as opposed to a big block of text), which is from using `std::move`.

## Additional information

Used LocalVector for TextEdit gutters, text, carets, and gutter info.
And in various methods where possible.
Only `indent_ofs` needed to be mutable, not the whole text Vector.
Carets are copied for undo/redo but I don't think it is an issue.

Optimized insert and remove text to use `std::move` 
Added changed checked for `Text::set`.

Reserved in a few places like `get_sorted_carets` and `get_default_word_separators`.

When adding a newline at the start of a line, it is intended that it is the same as adding a line before. So instead of moving the old gutters and hidden state and resetting them on the new line, I swap it instead. This also fixes an issue where the background color wasn't moved too.

Cleaned up `_base_insert_text` too.
The `p_char` should never be after the line length, and adding one space at a time for it is not very efficient. It can't happen from `_insert`, and undo should always have a valid position in the text, so if it does ever happen, it is probably a bug with the undo system.

Test project: 
[textedit-perf_2026-08-07_22-32-25.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30849262/textedit-perf_2026-08-07_22-32-25.zip)
